hooks.name: Cost Check
hooks.description: Identify added/modified/removed resources, estimate monthly cost delta via aws-pricing MCP, append to infra/cost-estimates.md, flag if delta > $200/mo.

action.prompt: Identify added/modified/removed resources. Use the aws-pricing MCP to estimate the monthly cost delta. Append to infra/cost-estimates.md. FLAG LOUDLY if delta > $200/mo (Part 27 tripwire).
